时笙回想了下剧情，身子一跃，跳出火焰的范围，“卧槽，把这茬忘了。”

凤辞看着她的动作，睫毛颤了颤，也不知道在想什么，那专注的神情，像是在看一件极为珍贵的宝贝。

凤辞……

本文中最大的反派，阻碍女主登上巅峰的终极绊脚石。

他是凤族和龙族结合而生，但是他一出生身上就燃烧着熊熊大火，那火焰没有温度，却能将有生命的东西烧成灰烬。

无人敢靠近他，就连他的亲身父母都不敢随便靠近，一不小心就会被火焰灼伤。

凤族和龙族本就不合，凤辞又是这样子，他父亲觉得他不详，后悔和他母亲在一起，而他母亲为了他父亲，就将凤辞抛弃了。

凤辞。

讽刺。

他第一次出场是在仙界，女主刚飞升，男主去迎接，凤辞正巧从下界上来，四周的人纷纷退避三舍，最后只剩下女主和男主站着没动。

女主是不认识凤辞，但是男主却是和凤辞不对付。

男主是龙族的少主，自然看不上凤辞这个龙凤结合而生的异类，但是因为凤辞的特别，平时他见到凤辞是不会主动挑衅的，可当时有女主在，男主自然不能怂，挡住了凤辞的路。

凤辞非常牛掰的一把火烧了飞升台，那场火足足烧了三天。

当时女主露出了诧异和戒备的表情，不过作者没有解释原因，现在看来，他们原来在这里见过？

时笙上下摸了摸，确定没什么大碍。

那火烧一烧，本宝宝会死的。

刚才她怎么就那么不长脑子进去了呢？肯定是被后面那玩意追得智商下线了！

不过……

为什么她没事啊？

刚才她在里面站了那么长的时间，就算有个缓冲，也缓冲过头了吧？

还是说本宝宝皮糙肉厚？

【鉴于目标太过特殊，系统特意给了你无视凤辞火焰的BUG。】

原来真的有金手指，那你丫的之前怎么不给我？

我的新手礼包呢？

宿主你的重点不对啊！还有新手礼包的梗你要记多久！

“商师姐！”叶清秋的身形猛的朝着她冲了过来，她后面还跟着胤蛇。

握草草草草！

女主大人你想干什么！

叶清秋将胤蛇引到时笙旁边，伸手要推时笙。

Shi Sheng recalled the plot, jumped out of the flames, "Damn it, I forgot about this."

Feng Ci watched her movements, her eyelashes trembled, and she didn't know what she was thinking. Her focused expression seemed to be looking at an extremely precious treasure.

Feng Ci...

The biggest villain in this article is the ultimate stumbling block that prevents the heroine from reaching the top.

He was born from the combination of the Phoenix Clan and the Dragon Clan, but as soon as he was born, his body was burning with blazing fire. The flame had no temperature, but could burn living things to ashes.

No one dared to approach him, not even his biological parents, as they would be burned by the flames if they were not careful.

The Feng Clan and the Dragon Clan were at odds with each other, and Feng Ci was like this. His father felt that he was unknown and regretted being with his mother, and his mother abandoned Feng Ci for his father.

Phoenix Ci.

Satire.

The first time he appeared was in the fairy world. The heroine had just ascended and the hero went to greet her. Feng Ci happened to come up from the lower world, and everyone around them retreated. In the end, only the heroine and the hero were left standing.

The female protagonist doesn't know Feng Ci, but the male protagonist doesn't deal with Feng Ci.

The male protagonist is the young master of the dragon clan, so he naturally looks down on Feng Ci, an alien born from the union of dragon and phoenix. However, because of Feng Ci's special nature, he would not take the initiative to provoke Feng Ci when he saw her. But with the female protagonist around at that time, the male protagonist naturally could not be cowardly and block Feng Ci's way.

Feng Ci was so awesome that he set fire to the ascension platform, and the fire burned for three days.

At that time, the heroine showed a surprised and wary expression, but the author did not explain the reason. Now it seems that they have met here before?

Shi Sheng touched it up and down to make sure it was nothing serious.

If the fire burns, this baby will die.

Why was she so clueless just now?He must have been chased by that thing behind him to the point where his IQ dropped!

But...

Why is she okay?

She had stood there for such a long time just now. Even if there was a buffer, was it too much?

Or do you mean that this baby has rough skin and thick flesh?

[In view of the fact that the target is too special, the system has specially given you a BUG that allows you to ignore Feng Ci’s flames.】

It turns out there really is a golden finger, so why didn’t you give it to me before?

Where is my newbie gift pack?

Host, your focus is wrong!And how long do you have to remember the novice gift pack!

"Senior Sister Shang!" Ye Qingqiu rushed toward her, with Yin She following behind her.

Hold the grass!

Mistress, what do you want to do?

Ye Qingqiu led Yinshe to Shi Sheng's side and stretched out his hand to push Shi Sheng.
